## Implementation (commit f6ff9a12527, make verify running, not pushed yet)

- Root-cause fix: `janitor.startup_sweep` walks outside the accounting lock and resets the byte total only when the entry set (name + directory inode) is unchanged across the walk.
- Reproduction re-run on the fix: with the walk delayed 15 s, the concurrent ticket-snapshot build waited 0.5 s (15.0 s at 39d78c81fd5). The new test `test_a_snapshot_build_publishes_while_the_startup_walk_runs` times out against main's janitor and passes on the fix.
- Pre-LLM steps (`existing_vote_check`, `commit_fetch`, `clone`, `snapshot`, `diff_fetch`) each log a `review_step` line before starting and run under `review_timeout_seconds()/4` = 300 s; `llm_review` logs its start and stays under the 1200 s review bound. A step timeout gives one VOTER_ERROR naming the step, no vote, status `error` (retryable).
- Scratch folder: `ReviewScratch` keeps `reviewbot-*` until the last step thread in it returns; no step starts after abandonment; every attempt makes a new folder. Runbook review-bot-ops.md and ADR 0112 updated to name it (added to file_impact after the plan-review advisory).
- Local: 480 review-bot/snapshot unit tests pass; make lint and make typecheck pass (mechanism ratchet exit 0).
